evidence: Measured 2026-11-20 on 537 names and 440 trading days (a short sample): fitted on up to 260 days, checked on the following 21 and 63 sessions. Across all names the hold is weak (rank correlation +0.15). Among names with |t| of 2.5 or more (rates 8% of names, oil 12%), the sign of the next move against the index was right 60% to 67% of the time. The exposures do not forecast: they say what a stock gains or loses WHEN a driver moves. Annotation only; never a gate, a score or a size.
